title: Downlink Cat shot list (v1, anime style, the house default)
description: What a director model writes for one anime Short. The builder checks it with lib/validate_anime.mjs, which adds the rules that depend on the narration (anchors, beat order, hard cuts only on a hit or an impact, the flash limit, numbers on screen against the fact table, the cast's visits) and reports each problem with its path. Anchors: "word", "word#2", "word@end", "word+4f", "word-6f" or a frame number. Screen coordinates are px of the 1080 x 1920 frame; diagram coordinates are units of the diagram's size box. See DIRECTOR.md part A and examples/artemis_anime, examples/mmx_anime.

bed.description: A bed id from lab/sound/beds/beds.json (never the previous Short's).

facts.description: The fact table (factcheck.md or facts.md); every number on screen must appear in it or in the narration.

stress.description: Emphasis words: drawn as emphasis lettering (numbers are emphasised automatically).

impacts.description: Words that get ONE impact frame. At most 3 in any second, at least 10 frames apart; keep about 2 s apart.

beats.description: First a hook on a real photo, then the story, a NEXT band and scene, last the end card.

text.description: A line of on-screen text, or { t, c } with c amber, muted, red or paper.

file.description: jpg, png (alpha kept for cutouts) or webp, relative to the shot list's folder.

credit.description: Exactly as the source gives it; drawn on every frame the photo is on screen.

focus.description: [x, y, w, h] of the subject as fractions of the image: framing centres on it.

fill.description: Zoom so the focus box fills this fraction of a frame's width (for small subjects inside big images).

hit.description: The start word is a hit word: a hard cut is allowed.

source.description: The source of the facts of a drawn beat ("Illustration · facts: NASA").

shot.description: hook/photo: image, frame (full, panel, circle, cutout, monitor), push, keys [{at, zoom, focus, frames}], punch [anchors], marks [{at, point, r}], scan {at, until}, overlay (focus, speed), bg, pull, lean_at, sparkle, slam. number: text, at, y, size, bg, art (a craft spec), image. craft: craft (capsule, crew-capsule, rocket, rocket-slim, probe, rover, satellite), bg (space, limb, sky, sea, pad, earth, mars, moon, phobos, plasma...), backdrop {...}, pos, scale, rot, keys [{at, pos, scale, rot, frames}], ease, drift, plasma {at, until}, chutes {at}, splash {at}, liftoff {at}, burn {at}, arm {at}, legs, wing, window, speed, push. compare: layout (lens, stack, side), items [{image | craft, focus, label, at, value, value_at, value_sub, tone}]. diagram: size, region, backdrop {kind, y, r, angle, lines}, camera [{at, zoom, center, frames}], elements [{path, id, color, dash, width, at, draw} | {heat, from, to, at} | {craft, path, keys [{at, u}], size} | {label, pos, color, at} | {marker (stop, x, dot), pos, angle, at} | {ring, pulse} | {body, pos, r} | {zone}]. react: who (ns, pho), faces [{at, expr, p}], bg, rim, pos, size, turn_in, look, paw {at, close_at}, reticle {at, piece_at}, piece. band: style (1, 2, 3, 4, next), words [from, to] or label, num, step, steps, stamp {text, at}, expr, face, lead. next: scene (moon, rocket, earth, mars) or image, chip [lines], chip_at, stamp {text, at, x, y}. end: downlink, cat.
